verdict.rationale: Appwrite's database docs list VectorsDB as a first-party product to "Store embeddings and run similarity search to power AI features," which covers both parts of the story. Its managed PostgreSQL option also supports installing pgvector. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the vector API (index types, distance metrics, query syntax, dimension limits), independent or hands-on corroboration that VectorsDB similarity search works in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store embeddings and run vector similarity search for AI features
